public_rationale: The evidence supports uneven gains: DeepSeek documented several areas where R1 remained worse than V3. But the records also show improvements outside math and coding. Marcus said 'such as,' so those additional gains do not automatically refute him. The stronger comparison with the breadth of earlier GPT advances remains unsettled without a common evaluation and a clearer breadth threshold.
limitations: The decisive model evaluations are developer-reported.
Treating across-the-board improvement as literally zero regressions would make the claim easier to support than its ordinary reading warrants.

statement.document_title: Five ways in which the last 3 months — and especially the DeepSeek era — have vindicated “Deep learning is hitting a wall"

from_speaker: like GPT-4 was relative to GPT-3

our_interpretation: The plain reading is that contemporary reasoning systems offered selective improvements rather than a similarly broad advance in general usefulness. Coding and math are examples, not an exhaustive list.
Across the board means broad improvement across ordinary task categories, not improvement on every individual benchmark.
The target period is the three months preceding publication, following the post's stated context. Assessments concern model versions available then.
A direct comparison with earlier GPT transitions requires reasonably comparable task coverage and baselines.
criteria.support_condition: Cross-domain evaluations show that contemporary reasoning models' improvements were concentrated in selected domains, with substantial ordinary task categories showing little improvement or regression, and materially narrower gains than the earlier GPT transitions.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable evaluations show broad improvements across technical and nontechnical tasks, similar in breadth to the earlier GPT transitions.

evidence.explanation: These limitations support the selective-improvement reading. However, the same report also describes gains in factual questions, document analysis, writing, and open-domain answering, so it does not establish that improvements were narrowly confined.
The factuality evaluations provide material evidence of benefits beyond math and coding. They do not by themselves establish an advance comparable in breadth to the earlier GPT transitions.
